environment: Local Final preview on http://127.0.0.1:5176, simulated accounts
scope: Move Dashboard from Final outer navigation into Address menu for Lite and Pro, retaining mode and chain

observations.issue: Floating Telegram widget and expanded design-preview tools can cover the bottom-right Theme control in an open responsive menu
observations.status: Observed during QA; collapsed tools and hid widget through UI to complete menu tests; unrelated widget behavior was not changed

limitations: Browser viewport tests, not physical-device tests
The additional legacy NavBar real-wallet integration suite has five setup failures (ResizeObserver missing, connector uid undefined); the three targeted suites pass 98 tests
